name: Azeroth Companion
title: SOVEREIGN PRIVATE VIDEO VAULT — Password-Encrypted Personal Media & Command Pulse
approval_note: Owner approved a real password-protected personal vault and additive improvements to existing Azeroth functionality. Device/codec acceptance remains pending; content is private browser-local ciphertext, not cloud video hosting.
features: New Sovereign Private Video Vault encrypts videos, titles and private notes locally using AES-256-GCM and a password-derived key, never uploading media to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare.
Support for local MP4/MOV/M4V/WebM/OGV/OGG imports, encrypted file parts, personal title/note editing, favorites, search and native private browser playback.
Encrypted portable .nxvault backups and opt-in restore into an empty device/browser, plus manual lock, background security and strict no-network vault policies.

A more useful Living Command Center now shows the real local status of manual Atlas missions, expedition routes, saved Adventure Operations and Talent Forge drafts in a premium Continue Your Adventure panel.
Vault access integrated into Command Center search, main companion sidebar, World Atlas and Character Nexus. All older tools, account verification, music, saves and Cloudflare backend retained.

Privacy scope: each browser/device owns its local media archive. A password cannot make publicly hosted GitHub video files private; optional server-backed cross-device vault would require future secure storage infrastructure.
